_comment: Example: a ride-hailing backend on the SAME pgforge binary, by config alone. Roles (rider/driver) are declared in '_roles' and self-register. Access rules show all three scope kinds: owner_column (EQ) forces ownership on create; owner_any (OR) lets one caller match via either of several columns; owner_via (relationship) confines reads to rows the caller participates in, via a membership table. Public reads (vehicle_types) open to 'anon'. '_default':'deny' is the secure posture — every exposed table is listed explicitly, and any table without an entry is denied. Point pgforge at this file with PGF_POLICY_FILE.
